notes.title: We have just released a major update of our game "Elden Gunfire 2"
notes.notes:
Hello everyone

-We have just released a major update of our game "Elden Gunfire 2":
-new advanced bots system more challenging
-new HD graphics
-better graphics screen space effects
-new third person camera angle of view
-new fast input system
-adjusted game UI
-major bugs fixed (health some times does not decrease, reloading animation bug, scoreboard not visible in private match)

notes.title: Check out our new multiplayer Shooter in Steam
notes.notes:
Hello everyone
We want our community to stay updated with our latest news, we just published "Army Troop" in Steam, a new strong modern WW2 multiplayer shooter for everyone, check it out, and wishlist if you like it to support us, we were delayed working on it, so we will add more contents to all our games very soon.
Thank you for your patience and support

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2215270/Army_Troop/?beta=0
